decisions.reason: High prior investment and a dedicated product page signal strong public commitment, so management is likely to persist despite disappointing results.
As an ongoing illustrated release series with its own page, it represents a visible, ongoing commitment that management will justify by continuing.
The reissued jazz vinyl required licensing and production investment and had its own page, creating escalation pressures that favor keeping it.
The multi-disc box set entailed substantial production costs and public commitment via its own page, so management is inclined to persist.
Only a brief website mention indicates low investment and low public commitment, making it easier to drop when results are poor.
